cases.customer_question: What qualification activities should be planned when a Bluetooth product requires RF testing, RF-PHY testing, declaration support, and compliance-folder creation under a Multi-Design qualification approach?
question_variants: What services are needed for Multi-Design qualification?
RF and RF-PHY testing plus declaration support
How should a Bluetooth certification project be structured?
What activities are included in Bluetooth qualification execution?
cases.actual_issue: The project required coordinated planning of multiple Bluetooth qualification workstreams, including RF testing, mandatory RF-PHY testing, Bluetooth SIG declaration support using a Multi-Design approach, compliance-folder creation, and collection of prerequisite qualification information before execution.
cases.plain_english_explanation: Bluetooth qualification projects often involve more than testing alone. In addition to RF and RF-PHY verification, teams may need declaration support, compliance documentation, questionnaires, and customer confirmation forms. Planning these activities together helps prevent delays during execution.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant defined the planned qualification scope as RF Full testing for a Class 2 device, RF-PHY testing for the mandatory 1M PHY, Multi-Design declaration support, and compliance-folder creation. The team confirmed that sample-modification instructions and qualification questionnaires had already been supplied and planned to issue a declaration-content confirmation form once the customer order was received. Qualification preparation activities were organized before formal execution to enable efficient project startup.
cases.decision_logic: Bluetooth qualification execution depends on both technical testing and administrative qualification preparation. RF testing, RF-PHY testing, declaration planning, compliance documentation, and customer qualification inputs must all be coordinated before project execution begins.
cases.final_recommendation: Before testing begins, define the complete qualification scope, distribute questionnaires and declaration-confirmation forms, prepare compliance-folder activities, and verify that RF test samples and supporting documentation are ready.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Incomplete preparation can delay testing, declaration activities, or compliance documentation work and may require additional coordination after the project has already started.
